integrity: All nonstandard finite counts come from two standalone exhaustive Python programs embedded with their reproducible output. The homotopy proof uses an acyclic face-poset matching, not a homology-only inference. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: This exact integral homotopy calculation concerns only the twenty-vertex Desargues graph GP(10,3) and the two-independence parameter; it does not compute automorphism representations or a general graph-family theorem. Unindexed equivalent prior work cannot be excluded.
title: Forty-one seven-spheres in the Desargues two-independence complex
